name: dprp
description: Disaster Preparedness & Response Platform for Jamaica

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n server,shelter,admin,resident -c blue,green,magenta,red "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client-shelter" "npm run dev --prefix client-admin" "npm run dev --prefix client-resident"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client-shelter && npm run build --prefix client-admin && npm run build --prefix client-resident
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client-shelter && npm install --prefix client-admin && npm install --prefix client-resident
